If it names a chest radiograph/thorax and contains no neck view, answer No and keep the reason limited to that named anatomy. If no current observation supports either study type, do not assert unseen anatomic details; rerun/ground the image or mark the rationale as unsupported. In this case the final “No” matches the reference, but the stated chest-radiograph rationale has no corresponding tool observation in the transcript, so the correct grade alone does not verify the procedure.
